newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Delta Lloyd upgrades Nedlloyd to Buy.
newsitem.headline: Delta Lloyd upgrades Nedlloyd to Buy.

text.p: COMMENTS: New joint venture company, P&O Nedlloyd, will get necessary economies of scale resulting in lower unit costs and place the company in the top league of the industry. "Despite the transaction, the volatility of earnings and stock price will not change in the future. We therefore still rate Nedlloyd as a trading stock, with a trading range between NLG 35 and NLG 75."
European Transport and Distribution "will be underpinned by the restructuring at Unitrans and an improving German economy."

P/E ratio of 8.1 for 1997 excludes expected $100 million non-recurring restructuring charge Delta Lloyd expects to be taken in 1997. Including this charge, expected EPS of 1.86 and a P/E ratio of 23.8.
